thread:
Ava (Marketing): Quick sync — planning a tiny micro-cohort webinar + credit activation hooks. Goal: 100 starters from our seed cohort. Ideas?
Sam (Growth): Love it. Keep it short (30m), show 3 prompts -> immediate wins, then 100 credits follow-up.
Nadia (Product): Can we make the prompt templates live in the console during the webinar? Live edit demo = big conversion lift.
Riya (Onboarding): We can auto-attach a 100-credit grant for attendees who complete the quick starter flow. Need the criteria spelled out.
Lee (Ops): From infra POV, we should route webinar traffic to the dedicated demo model to avoid noisy latency blips. I'll add a temporary route policy.
Ava (Marketing): Draft flow: 1) sign-up page -> 2) confirmation + 100-credit promise -> 3) webinar invite (calendar) -> 4) post-webinar starter email with 3 prompt templates + CTA.
Sam (Growth): Email cadence proposal (short): `Day0: confirm & credit note`, `Day1: webinar reminder`, `Day2: handoff with prompts + quickstart`, `Day5: nudge` — keep copy modular for A/B.
Nadia (Product): We'll prepare 3 prompt packs: "Cold Email Helper", "Code Explain & Fix", "Customer-Support Snippets". Each has 2 starter prompts + tweak suggestions.
Riya (Onboarding): Handoff rules: attendees who click CTA -> hit `onboard-start` route -> we mark them as "starter" and show inline checklist. If they hit the checklist step 2, grant bonus 50 credits.
Lee (Ops): Example rollout policy snippet (temp):
```
route_policy: 
  - cohort: seed-webinar-mar24
    model: dedicated-redwood-v1
    fallback: hosted-redwood-r2
    quota: 120/min
```
Ava (Marketing): Copy note for landing page: "Join a 30-minute hands-on demo + get 100 credits to try Redwood in your app. Live prompt templates, real-time debugging, no vendor lock-in." Short + benefit-forward.
Sam (Growth): Metrics to track: landing CVR, webinar attendance rate, starter activation (first 5 API calls), 7-day retention. Also cost-per-starter (credits consumed).
Riya (Onboarding): We'll need a small checklist + in-product modal. Who owns the modal? @Nadia?
Nadia (Product): Happy to own the modal UX. Riya, can you draft the checklist items (3 steps) by EOD tomorrow?
Riya (Onboarding): Yep — will do. Draft: `Connect API key`, `Run first prompt (use example)`, `Save prompt to library`.
Lee (Ops): Can we gate the 100 credits so they only appear after modal completion? Simple flagging on the user object should work. I'll work with @Nadia on the API contract.
Ava (Marketing): Promotion channels: in-app banner, email to seed cohort, a small paid funnel (LinkedIn sponsor) targeted to dev leads. Keep copy consistent.
Sam (Growth): Quick A/B ideas: A) 100 credits upfront vs B) 50 on signup + 50 after checklist. Hypothesis: B reduces credit abuse, maybe increases completions.
Ava (Marketing): Good. Let's test B as main + A as holdout 30%.
Calendar Bot: Event created: "Seed Cohort Micro-Webinar — 30m" on 2026-04-02 17:00 UTC. Attendees: Ava, Sam, Nadia, Lee, Riya.
Ava (Marketing): Action items roundup: Sam — landing + cadences. Nadia — modal + prompt packs. Riya — checklist + gating criteria. Lee — route policy + credit gating. I'll draft landing by tomorrow AM and post doc here: https://docs.google.com/example-seed-webinar
Sam (Growth): I'll wire analytics and set up the A/B. Sending kickoff brief in a sec. :rocket:
Riya (Onboarding): Quick Q — should the bonus 50 credits be visible in the UI or only via email? My vote: show in UI after completion (better UX).
Nadia (Product): UI visible. Helps trust and reduces support tickets.
Lee (Ops): Note — set a soft cap per user: 100 credits + 50 bonus, expire in 30 days. I'll add to policy.
Ava (Marketing): Perfect. Let's reconvene after draft landing. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
